name: Credit-Stress De-Risk Gate on Equity ETFs (HY-spread momentum x quiet-VIX divergence)
rationale: Default-LONG large-cap equity ETFs (SPY/QQQ + liquid sector ETFs); time the long exposure off HY credit-spread DIRECTION via crossings, NOT a static level filter. THESIS: HY credit spreads lead equity drawdowns by 1-3 months because the credit market prices deteriorating fundamentals through actual lending/default activity before equities do. ENGINE-FAITHFUL MECHANICS (verified against cosmu/data/backtest.py _condition_true): credit_spread is a raw point-in-time alt-data series, so a bare gt/lt level filter on it would be the DRIFTING always-true/false TRAP the brief forbids. We instead trigger ONLY on the cross_up / cross_down events — the bar where the HY-OAS level crosses a fitted threshold from one side to the other. A crossing fires on the TRANSITION (a state change in the credit regime), not on a persistent level, so it sidesteps the drift trap and is directional by construction. NOTE/HONESTY: the engine evaluates cross_up/cross_down as a one-bar RAW-LEVEL crossing of the OAS percentage-point level (prev<=thr<curr), NOT a multi-week rate-of-change z-score — the backtester ignores lookback on alt-data features, so the 'percentile/change' framing of the original thesis is reduced to a level-transition. HYSTERESIS to cut churn: the de-risk-up threshold band (spread_widen_derisk) sits ABOVE the re-arm-down band (spread_tighten_arm), so we flatten when OAS crosses up through the wider level and only re-enter when it crosses back down through the tighter level — no rapid in/out around a single line. CONFLUENCE GATE: re-enter the long ONLY when vix_level is also BELOW a fitted complacency level — the 'spreads tightening while VIX quiet' all-clear, which keeps us out during the discount-rate / pure-vol regimes (2022, 2020) where credit-spread timing historically failed and concentrates exposure in the credit-led calm. Low-turnover by construction (a few transitions a year), which is why an alpha desk under a Sharpe budget skips it and a fee-aware daily book can harvest it. DISCONFIRMERS: (1) replace the credit_spread crossings with same-direction crossings of dxy/macro_regime — if generic risk-off gives the same protection the credit signal adds nothing credit-specific; (2) ablate the cross_up/cross_down to a raw credit_spread gt/lt LEVEL filter — if the static level alone works it is the fitted DRIFTING artifact and the crossing adds nothing; (3) compare to buy-and-hold SPY net of 2x the round-trip fee — if the timed in/out version does not beat always-long after costs, the churn is destroying the edge. The signal must add return specifically through the credit-led de-risk transitions, not by being out of the market on average.
catalyst: HY credit-spread (OAS) level crosses up through a fitted wider threshold -> flatten the long (de-risk); crosses back down through a fitted tighter threshold while VIX is below a complacency level -> re-enter the long. Credit-regime transition, not a static level.
